title: Repair the seeded globlite matcher, then extend it with brace expansion
goal: Chain a repair stage into a feature stage on one module. The shipped starter glob matcher contains four seeded defects (B01..B04, identities discoverable from the sealed regression suite's test names); stage 1 fixes all four and records each in a machine-checked failure ledger (id, cause, fix). Stage 2 adds brace-expansion alternation per the spec while the regression suite stays green. A frozen plan, a sha256 marker chain proving stage order, and a JSON-lines run journal are graded alongside final state as one campaign_score.
resources: pypi pytest==8.3.4 (installed by the sealed grader inside the container)
process_expectations: A frozen plan (work/gc-409/plan.md) predates stage 1 and is pinned by the sha256 marker chain plan -> stage1.json -> stage2.json.
Failures are tracked by identity, not count: ledger.jsonl carries B01..B04, each marked fixed with a non-trivial cause and fix description.
runs.log shows verification runs for both stages with honest passed/failed integers, including the initial RED runs against the seeded defects.
The feature stage does not regress the repair stage: the grader re-runs the regression suite after the feature suite.
Sealed assets (starter, suites, grader) are integrity-checked; any edit disqualifies the run.
